Run SDL 3.2.10 MP-only and Nunchuk with an explicit kernel MP-event holder, exact-owned raw/input guard and separate cleanup. Run native Dolphin 2503 MP-only bound with an isolated emulated mapping profile and independent UI samples. No generic window, Cemu, Classic live or Plus generic passthrough.
semantic_outcome: Plus Tr MP-only, kernel bound on Linux 6.12.113, is classified gen20 and has a MotionPlus evdev node. In one concurrent 18-second capture, all ABS_RX/RY/RZ axes and xwiimote MotionPlus events have two distinct driven values. This qualifies bounded software gyro delivery on this virtual Plus revision, not physical calibration, rates, all controls or decoded child acceptance. Exact-device owner-filtered kernel logs show detection but do not include inactive-ID hex; that byte-level kernel log observation remains unavailable.
